principles: Playbook never auto-files findings or touches gates
active requires explicit human approval; approve -> candidate only
Lineage mandatory (traceable to a source finding/story)
Digest fail-closed via core/digest.js (clone decision-doc, not import from it)
Source-of-truth playbooks.json/proposals under the excluded .lattice/learning/ prefix
drivers: Determinism: learning must not become a judge
Auditability: every playbook has lineage + a stable proposalDigest

options.name: dedicated-playbooks-json-staged-proposals
pros: Source-of-truth under the already-excluded .lattice/learning/ prefix; no gate pollution
Avoids dev-memory content-sha7 id-hash hazard for mutable status
Clones the proven decision-doc digest fail-closed pattern via the core/digest.js leaf
cons: New CLI surface needs command-policy/config/registry wiring

options.name: overload-dev-memory-with-status
cons: dev-memory id = content sha7; mutable status/promotionHistory would break dedup/idempotency unless excluded from the id-hash; more hazardous

rationale: A dedicated playbooks.json/proposals store under .lattice/learning/ keeps lifecycle status off dev-memory's content-hash id, stays gate-excluded, and cloning the decision-doc digest pattern via the core/digest.js leaf gives fail-closed integrity without handler-to-handler coupling.

preMortem.scenario: A playbook auto-creates a finding or influences a gate
preMortem.trigger: Wiring playbook approve into finding_add / advisory
preMortem.consequence: Learning becomes a judge -> violates determinism
preMortem.mitigation: playbook.ts never imports finding_add/advisory; smoke asserts no finding created + gate untouched after the full lifecycle
approve requires expectedProposalDigest == stored proposalDigest (fail-closed, decision-doc pattern); smoke covers stale-digest rejection

preMortem.consequence: Skips human approval for the high-trust state
preMortem.mitigation: approve yields candidate only; active requires a separate explicit human step; smoke asserts status=candidate after approve
propose requires a finding id; lineage sourceStoryId/sourceFindingId/sourceSignature is mandatory; smoke asserts lineage on the candidate

preMortem.scenario: playbook.ts imports the digest helper from a handler
preMortem.mitigation: import digestCanonicalJson from core/digest.js (leaf); smoke/static check
